verdicts.missing: The quote supports that Django 4.2 supports MariaDB 10.4 and higher, but not that the upgrade crosses Django 4.2; that is a deployment hypothesis, though the framing makes the core supported.

The quote only says upstream support for MariaDB 10.3 ends in May 2023. It does not state that Django 4.2 drops support for versions older than 10.4, nor that deployments on MariaDB older than 10.4 are affected.
